description: MotionMeet üye, içerik, etkileşim, medya, arka plan işleri (outbox) ve veritabanı sağlığı. Kaynak: docs/architecture/observability.md

targets.rawSql: select count(*) as value from users

panels.title: Yeni üye
panels.description: Seçili zaman aralığında kayıt olan üyeler.

targets.rawSql: select count(*) as value from users where $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: Aktif story
panels.description: 24 saati dolmamış story sayısı (şu an).

targets.rawSql: select count(*) as value from stories where expires_at > now()

panels.title: Gönderi
panels.description: Seçili aralıkta paylaşılan gönderiler.

targets.rawSql: select count(*) as value from posts where $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: Mesaj
panels.description: Seçili aralıkta gönderilen doğrudan mesajlar.

targets.rawSql: select count(*) as value from messages where $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: Antrenman
panels.description: Seçili aralıkta kaydedilen antrenmanlar.

targets.rawSql: select count(*) as value from workouts where $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: Etkinlik zaman çizelgesi
panels.description: Yeni üye, gönderi, story, mesaj ve antrenman sayıları.

targets.rawSql:
select $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, $__interval), 'Yeni üye' as metric, count(*) as value from users where $__timeFilter(created_at) group by 1
union all select $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, $__interval), 'Gönderi', count(*) from posts where $__timeFilter(created_at) group by 1
union all select $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, $__interval), 'Story', count(*) from stories where $__timeFilter(created_at) group by 1
union all select $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, $__interval), 'Mesaj', count(*) from messages where $__timeFilter(created_at) group by 1
union all select $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, $__interval), 'Antrenman', count(*) from workouts where $__timeFilter(created_at) group by 1
order by 1

panels.title: Gönderi tipleri
panels.description: Seçili aralıktaki gönderilerin tipi (sunucunun eklerden türettiği tip).

targets.rawSql: select post_type as metric, count(*) as value from posts where $__timeFilter(created_at) group by 1 order by 2 desc

panels.title: Etkileşim
panels.description: Beğeni, yorum, takip ve story görüntülemeleri.

targets.rawSql:
select $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, $__interval), 'Beğeni' as metric, count(*) as value from post_likes where $__timeFilter(created_at) group by 1
union all select $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, $__interval), 'Yorum', count(*) from post_comments where $__timeFilter(created_at) group by 1
union all select $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, $__interval), 'Takip', count(*) from user_follows where $__timeFilter(created_at) group by 1
union all select $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, $__interval), 'Story görüntüleme', count(*) from story_views where $__timeFilter(created_at) group by 1
order by 1
select visibility as metric, count(*) as value from posts where $__timeFilter(created_at) group by 1 order by 2 desc

panels.title: En çok etkileşim alan gönderiler
panels.description: Seçili aralıkta paylaşılan gönderiler; içerik metni gösterilmez.

targets.rawSql:
select author_username as "Yazar", post_type as "Tip", visibility as "Görünürlük",
       like_count as "Beğeni", comment_count as "Yorum", created_at as "Paylaşıldı"
from posts where $__timeFilter(created_at)
order by like_count + comment_count desc, created_at desc
limit 10

panels.title: Outbox bekleyen
panels.description: Henüz teslim edilmemiş olaylar. Sürekli artıyorsa worker veya RabbitMQ'ya bakın (RUNBOOKS.md).

targets.rawSql: select count(*) as value from outbox_events where status in ('pending', 'processing')

panels.title: Outbox dead
panels.description: 10 denemeyi tüketip bekletilen olaylar. 0 olmalı; çözümü RUNBOOKS.md → Dead events.

targets.rawSql: select count(*) as value from outbox_events where status = 'dead'

panels.title: En eski bekleyen olay
panels.description: Teslim gecikmesi. Normalde birkaç saniye.

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(extract(epoch from now() - min(created_at)), 0) as value from outbox_events where status in ('pending', 'processing')

panels.title: Medya silme kuyruğu
panels.description: S3'ten silinmeyi bekleyen nesneler (zamanlayıcı 10 dakikada bir boşaltır).

targets.rawSql: select count(*) as value from media_deletion_jobs

panels.title: Hata alan silme işleri
panels.description: En az bir kez başarısız olmuş S3 silmeleri.

targets.rawSql: select count(*) as value from media_deletion_jobs where attempts > 0

panels.title: Süpürülmemiş rezervasyon
panels.description: Süresi 30 dakikadan fazla önce dolmuş upload rezervasyonları. 0'dan büyükse zamanlayıcı çalışmıyor olabilir.

targets.rawSql: select count(*) as value from upload_reservations where expires_at < now() - interval '30 minutes'

panels.title: Teslim edilen olaylar
panels.description: Outbox'tan çıkan olaylar, tipe göre.

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroupAlias(published_at, $__interval), type as metric, count(*) as value from outbox_events where status = 'published' and $__timeFilter(published_at) group by 1, 2 order by 1

panels.title: Tüketicilerin işlediği olaylar
panels.description: processed_events: her tüketicinin uyguladığı olaylar (tekrar teslimler sayılmaz).

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroupAlias(processed_at, $__interval), consumer as metric, count(*) as value from processed_events where $__timeFilter(processed_at) group by 1, 2 order by 1

panels.title: Sorunlu olaylar
panels.description: Dead ya da yeniden denenen outbox olayları, en yeni önce.

targets.rawSql:
select event_id as "Olay", type as "Tip", status as "Durum", attempts as "Deneme",
       left(last_error, 160) as "Son hata", next_attempt_at as "Sonraki deneme", updated_at as "Güncellendi"
from outbox_events
where status = 'dead' or (status in ('pending', 'processing') and attempts > 0)
order by updated_at desc
limit 20

panels.title: Yüklenen dosya
panels.description: Seçili aralıkta gönderilere eklenen dosyalar.

targets.rawSql: select count(*) as value from post_media where $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: Yüklenen veri
panels.description: Doğrulanmış dosya boyutlarının toplamı.

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(sum(file_size), 0) as value from post_media where $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: Boyutu ölçülen görseller
panels.description: Medya worker'ının genişlik/yükseklik doldurduğu görsellerin oranı. Düşükse worker veya S3 erişimine bakın.

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(100.0 * count(*) filter (where width is not null) / nullif(count(*), 0), 100) as value from post_media where media_type = 'image' and $__timeFilter(created_at)
select coalesce(avg(file_size), 0) as value from post_media where $__timeFilter(created_at) and file_size is not null

panels.title: Dosya tipleri
panels.description: Doğrulanmış MIME tipleri.

targets.rawSql: select mime_type as metric, count(*) as value from post_media where $__timeFilter(created_at) group by 1 order by 2 desc
select $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, $__interval), media_type as metric, coalesce(sum(file_size), 0) as value from post_media where $__timeFilter(created_at) group by 1, 2 order by 1
select pg_database_size(current_database()) as value

panels.title: Önbellek isabet oranı
panels.description: Okunan blokların bellekten karşılanma oranı. 99'un altı bellek veya sorgu planı sorununa işaret eder.

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(round(100.0 * blks_hit / nullif(blks_hit + blks_read, 0), 2), 100) as value from pg_stat_database where datname = current_database()

panels.title: Bağlantı
panels.description: Bu veritabanına açık bağlantılar.

targets.rawSql: select count(*) as value from pg_stat_activity where datname = current_database()
select count(*) as value from pg_stat_activity where datname = current_database() and wait_event_type = 'Lock'

panels.title: Bağlantılar (süreç rolü)
panels.description: application_name: motionmeet-api / motionmeet-worker / motionmeet-scheduler. Havuz bütçesi için DEPLOYMENT.md.

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(nullif(application_name, ''), '(diğer)') as metric, count(*) as value from pg_stat_activity where datname = current_database() group by 1 order by 2 desc

panels.title: En büyük tablolar
panels.description: Satır sayısı istatistik sayacından, sayaç sıfırlanmışsa (sunucu temiz kapanmadığında olur) planlayıcının tahmininden gelir; ikisi de yoksa ANALYZE çalıştırın. Ölü satır oranı yüksek ve boyut satıra göre büyükse tablo şişmiştir (VACUUM).

targets.rawSql:
select s.relname as "Tablo", pg_total_relation_size(s.relid) as "Boyut",
       greatest(s.n_live_tup, c.reltuples::bigint, 0) as "Satır (yaklaşık)",
       s.n_dead_tup as "Ölü satır", greatest(s.last_autovacuum, s.last_vacuum) as "Son vacuum",
       greatest(s.last_autoanalyze, s.last_analyze) as "Son analyze"
from pg_stat_user_tables s
join pg_class c on c.oid = s.relid
order by pg_total_relation_size(s.relid) desc
limit 10

title: MotionMeet Genel Bakış
